title.zh: REGULATION | EU Regulators Reportedly Question Binance Over Continued European Operations Despite Wind-Down Order

current_state.zh: EU regulators are reportedly pressing Binance over its continued European operations despite a wind-down order, raising compliance and market-access questions for the exchange in the region.
